Legal notices

Privacy, terms and accessibility.

Your rights as a patient, how we handle your information and how to ask for help if anything on this site is not accessible to you.

This notice describes how medical information about you may be used and disclosed and how you can get access to it. Federal HIPAA law requires us to protect the privacy of your health information, to notify you of our legal duties, and to follow the terms of the notice currently in effect.

Your rights include: getting a copy of your record and images, asking us to correct it, requesting confidential communications, asking us to limit what we share, getting a list of those with whom we have shared it, and filing a complaint if you believe your rights were violated.

⚠️ Reference text. Before launch this must be replaced with the center's official Notice of Privacy Practices, reviewed by its legal counsel or HIPAA compliance officer.

The content of this site is for information only and does not replace advice, diagnosis or treatment from a healthcare professional. Requesting an appointment through the form does not create a physician-patient relationship and does not confirm an appointment until our team contacts you.

If you have a medical emergency, call 911. Do not send clinical information through the forms on this site.

⚠️ Reference text, pending legal review.

This site was built following WCAG 2.1 level AA: sufficient contrast, full keyboard navigation, visible focus, alternative text on images, semantic structure for screen readers, and respect for the operating system's reduced-motion preference.

Our facility is wheelchair accessible. If you hit a barrier on this site or need the information in another format, call us at (305) 681-7555 or message us on WhatsApp at (786) 819-6086 and we will get it to you.

We serve everyone regardless of race, color, national origin, age, disability, sex, gender identity or background. We provide free language assistance: our entire staff is bilingual Spanish-English.

If you believe we have failed to meet this commitment, you can file a grievance by calling (305) 681-7555 or writing to billing@bestamericandiagnostics.com.
